mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate level (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever the rate is low, without additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over a 3-month period signals an economic slowdown that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 280) and ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a monetary policy response to economic weakness, which typically supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing bubble regime (HOUST > 1500), a decline in housing starts below 1500 units (thousands) signals the onset of a housing market correction, which triggers equity market sell-offs and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500 during a housing bubble regime, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of payroll employment (above 148 million) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 148 million, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 101 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, which triggers risk-off sentiment and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 101, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of strong real consumption (RSAFS > 640000 million dollars) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicates a robust consumer-driven economy, which supports corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the signal of a higher federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
